title: Operation Shaban Toll Rises to 109 as Forces Tighten Grip in Balochistan
detail: Security forces killed seven more militants in Operation Shaban, pushing the confirmed toll to 109 killed since the campaign's July 5 launch across Balochistan, according to state media. The operation runs on two fronts — against Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan in the Pashtun-majority north around Ziarat, and against the Balochistan Liberation Army in the Baloch-majority south around Lasbela and Khuzdar — following the Mangi Dam police-post attack that killed 27 police personnel in early July. Security forces recovered M4 rifles, submachine guns, and rocket launchers from militants killed in the latest clashes; officials pledged to continue operations 'until the last terrorist is eliminated.'
